```{r}
# Following function allows calculating biomass weighted body condition for each species and region. It joins the biomass predictions into the grid that is used for prediction. 
# Note: NWFSC prediction files are large and not stored on Github, rather on a local folder. 

get_wa <- function(species = c("arrowtooth", "perch", "shortspine", "dover", "dogfish"), sex = c("F", "M"), region = c("nwfsc", "pbs", "afsc")) {
  species <- match.arg(species)
  region <- match.arg(region)
  
  # Get biomass predictions. NWFSC preds are large and not on github, read in from a different folder
  # Get file name
  if (region == "nwfsc") {
    files <- list.files("biomass_predictions")
  } else {
    files <- list.files("../data-generated")
  }
  file <- files[grepl(region, files) & grepl(species, files)]
  # Read in predictions
  if (region %in% c("afsc", "pbs")) { # live in data-generated folder
    biomass_predictions <- readRDS(paste0("../data-generated/", file))
  } else if (region == "nwfsc" & species == "shortspine") { # nwfsc live locally, shortspine the only .rds file
    biomass_predictions <- readRDS(paste0("biomass_predictions/", file))
  } else { # reading in .rdata files for the other nwfsc species
    e <- new.env()
    load(paste0("biomass_predictions/", file), envir = e)
    obj_name <- ls(e)[1]
    biomass_predictions <- get(obj_name, envir = e)
  }

  # Add density and format the biomass predictions
  message("Adding density column to biomass predictions and setting coords...")
  
  if (region == "nwfsc") {
    biomass_predictions <- biomass_predictions |>
      mutate(density = plogis(est1) * exp(est2)) |>
      mutate(X = X*1000, Y = Y*1000) |> # converting km to m because crs32610 expects meters
      st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 32610) |>
      st_transform(3338) |>
      mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
             y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2]) |>
      select(x,y,density, year)
  }
  if (region %in% c("pbs", "afsc")) {
    biomass_predictions <- biomass_predictions |>
      st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
      st_transform(3338) |>
      mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
             y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2]) |>
      rename(density = biomass_density)
  }
  
  # Get body condition model
  path <- paste0("models/", species, ".rds") 
  model <- readRDS(path)$base_centered
  if (species == "perch") {
    model <- readRDS(path)$base
  }
  gc()
  
  # Get grid from surveyjoin removing species-specific data-sparse areas
  message("Getting grid and attempting spatial join...")
  grid <- switch(region,
                 "nwfsc" = surveyjoin::nwfsc_grid,
                 "pbs" = surveyjoin::dfo_synoptic_grid,
                 "afsc" = surveyjoin::afsc_grid)
  grid <- grid |>
    filter(!survey %in% c("Northern Bering Sea Crab/Groundfish Survey - Eastern Bering Sea Shelf Survey Extension", "Eastern Bering Sea Slope Bottom Trawl Survey", "Triennial"))
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "pacific spiny dogfish") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Bering", survey), !grepl("Aleutian",survey), !grepl("Gulf",survey), survey!="SYN WCHG")}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "dover sole") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Aleutian", survey))}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) %in% c("dover sole","shortspine thornyhead","pacific ocean perch", "pacific spiny dogfish")) {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Eastern Bering Sea Crab", survey))}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) %in% c("pacific ocean perch")) {
    grid <- grid |> filter(lat >= 40)}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "arrowtooth flounder") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(lat >= 34)
  }
  
  # Add time, length, sex to grid. Must be after the filters above.
  yrs <- intersect(unique(model$data$year), unique(biomass_predictions$year)) # AFSC has alternating years for some species
  grid <- expand_grid(grid, year = yrs) |>
    mutate(length_cm = mean(model$data$length_cm, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(log_length = mean(model$data$log_length, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(log_lengthc = mean(model$data$log_lengthc, na.rm=T)) |>
    mutate(region = region)
  if (sex == "F") {
    grid <- grid |> mutate(sex = "F")
  } else if (sex == "M") {grid <- grid |> mutate(sex = "M")}
  
  # Turn grid into spatial object for joining
  grid_sf <- grid |>
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>
    st_transform(3338)
  
  # Do spatial join to biomass_predictions by year, setting coordinates
  joined_grid_list <- list()
  for (yr in unique(grid$year)) {
    grid_year <- grid_sf |> filter(year == yr)
    biomass_year <- biomass_predictions |> filter(year == yr) |>select(-year)
    if (nrow(grid_year)>0 && nrow(biomass_predictions) >0) {
      joined_year <- grid_year |>
        st_join(biomass_year, join = st_nearest_feature, maxdist = 500)
      joined_grid_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- joined_year}}
  joined_grid <- bind_rows(joined_grid_list)
  
  # Set geometry and get the proportion_density weights
  final_grid <- joined_grid |>
    mutate(X = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1] / 1000, # divide to convert m to km because condition model expects km
           Y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2] / 1000) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    group_by(year) |>
    mutate(sum_density = sum(density), proportion_density = density / sum_density)
  
  rm(biomass_predictions, biomass_year, grid, grid_sf, joined_grid, joined_grid_list, joined_year)
  gc()
  
  # Predict body condition with biomass weights
  message("Predicting body condition on new data and getting weighted average...")
  if (region == "test_afsc") { # this if statement probably can be deleted after updating sdmTMB to most recent version
    weighted_condition <- get_index_split(
      model,
      newdata = final_grid,
      nsplit = length(unique(final_grid$year)),
      area = final_grid$proportion_density
    )
  } else{
    weighted_condition <- get_index(
      model,
      newdata = final_grid,
      area = final_grid$proportion_density
    )
  }
  
  # Calculating lower and upper confidence interval bounds
  z <- qnorm(0.975)
  weighted_condition$lwr <- weighted_condition$est - z * weighted_condition$se_natural
  weighted_condition$upr <- weighted_condition$est + z * weighted_condition$se_natural
  
  # Adding metadata to indices
  weighted_condition$species <- species
  weighted_condition$region <- region
  
  # Housekeeping
  if (region == "nwfsc" & species != "shortspine") { rm(e) }
  invisible(gc())
  return(weighted_condition)
}

# Getting indices for all region/species combinations
# Github does not want to store the large .rdata files for nwfsc
a <- get_wa("arrowtooth", "F", "nwfsc")
b <- get_wa("dover", "F", "nwfsc")
c <- get_wa("perch", "F", "nwfsc")
d <- get_wa("dogfish", "F", "nwfsc")
e <- get_wa("shortspine", "F", "nwfsc")

f <- get_wa("arrowtooth", "F", "pbs")
g <- get_wa("dover", "F", "pbs")
h <- get_wa("perch", "F", "pbs")
i <- get_wa("dogfish", "F", "pbs")
j <- get_wa("shortspine", "F", "pbs")

k <- get_wa("arrowtooth", "F", "afsc")
l <- get_wa("dover", "F", "afsc")
```

```{r}
# Testing if the year*region interaction is useful for prediction. Results: lower AIC values for arrowtooth flounder, dover sole, and pacific ocean perch No difference for pacific spiny dogfish and shortspine thornyhead (AIC diff < 2).
for (i in unique(indices$species)) {
  subset <- indices |> filter(species == i)
  fit1 <- lm(est ~ year*region, weights = se, data = subset)
  fit2 <- lm(est ~ year + region, weights = se, data = subset)
print(i)
  print(AIC(fit1, fit2))
}
```
